searches.purpose: Locate foundational sociology-of-knowledge and psychology statements, independent conceptual boundary analysis, contemporary empirical applications, institutional continuation and Portuguese-language or decolonial research while excluding Piagetian social constructivism, constructivist psychotherapy, generic uses of 'constructed', and empirical findings about one socially constructed category misrepresented as tests of the whole metatheory

items.title: Naturalistic Approaches to Social Construction
items.rights_note: Ron Mallon's independently edited SEP entry maps distinct objects, agents and meanings of construction and naturalistic responses; it is a conceptual boundary source, not a history of every constructionist school or evidence for a single unified theory.

items.title: The Social Construction of Reality: A Treatise in the Sociology of Knowledge
items.rights_note: Open Library record for the 1966 first Doubleday edition; preview or lending availability does not authorize caching or treating the copyrighted book body as read.

items.title: The Social Constructionist Movement in Modern Psychology
items.rights_note: Official Swarthmore faculty repository record and abstract for Gergen's first-generation psychology statement; the linked legacy PDF endpoint returned HTTP 404 to the collector, so the article body is not treated as retrieved or read.
items.failure_note: The repository's 'Link to Full Text' points to a legacy Swarthmore PDF URL that returned HTTP 404 on 2026-07-30; the official record is retained without using an unauthorized mirror.

items.title: Os sentidos da construção social: o convite construcionista para a psicologia
items.rights_note: SciELO marks this Portuguese-language review CC BY-NC 4.0; it describes plural origins, contributions, tensions and culturally situated knowledge practices and is conceptual synthesis rather than empirical validation.
items.failure_note: The USP journal PDF endpoint timed out to the collector on 2026-07-30; the same DOI's official SciELO PDF endpoint was selected without bypassing access controls.

items.title: The Social Construction of What?
items.rights_note: Open Library bibliographic record and publisher description for Hacking's independent differentiation of what construction claims target; no copyrighted book body is cached or treated as read.

items.title: Moving Beyond Social Categories by Incorporating Context in Social Psychological Theory
items.rights_note: Author-hosted copy presents social constructionism as one of three frameworks informing examples of context-sensitive social-psychological research; it explicitly is not exhaustive and does not validate social constructionism as one testable unit.
items.failure_note: The Nature publisher endpoint returned a 3 KB 'Client Challenge' shell to the collector; that file was removed and an author-hosted PDF selected without solving or bypassing the challenge.

items.title: Reconstructing Knowledge: A Constructionist-Decolonial Approach to Psychosocial Research in Peri-Urban Communities of South America
items.rights_note: Public Arden-hosted 2024 study by Eliana Perez Gonçalves de Moura combines intervention research, discursive idea-association maps and a constructionist-decolonial framing in one southern Brazilian peri-urban community; it supports a regional methodological example, not representation of all South American or Indigenous knowledge systems.

items.title: The Taos Institute: Creating Promising Futures Through Social Construction
items.rights_note: Current nonprofit institute self-description documents courses, publications, multilingual programming and practitioner activity; institutional continuation and global membership are not evidence of theoretical validity or population representativeness.
